title: JavaScript runner adapter against the existing runner contract (reuse, not redesign)
context: open-coding-curriculum is an open CC-BY (prose) / MIT (code) curriculum of beginner programming lessons with graded, runnable exercises across languages. Every exercise carries a reference solution proven correct in CI (solutionVerified:true), learner code runs zero-install in-browser via WASM, and all content is machine-readable structured data so third parties can build on it. The project targets absolute beginners — self-learners, public-library patrons, under-resourced school students, career-changers — and operates under a donated-compute lane with no server-side execution of learner code and no partner confirmed yet (verifiedNeed:false). The language-agnostic runner contract established in occ-runner-003 must be proven reusable by a second language before it is considered validated. Adding JavaScript should require only an adapter (using the browser's native JS engine) + content, with no schema or contract changes. This is the architectural proof-of-concept for multi-language support.
objective: Implement a JavaScript runner adapter against the runner contract from occ-runner-003 using the browser's native JavaScript engine, reusing the contract interface exactly, with no schema or core contract changes.
acceptanceCriteria: JavaScript adapter implements run(code, tests, limits) → { passed, failures[], stdout, durationMs, resourceUse } using the same contract interface as the Python adapter.
No changes are made to the core runner contract or lesson/exercise schemas to accommodate JavaScript.
JavaScript exercises can be graded client-side using the same runner integration used for Python.
CI correctness backend runs JavaScript reference solutions against their test suites using the adapter.
Adapter includes resource caps (execution time limit, graceful timeout) for the in-browser case.
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass.
output: A merged PR adding the JavaScript runner adapter that reuses the existing runner contract with no schema or contract changes.
